# U44: An owner stops a goal with history, then deletes a goal set up by mistake and undoes it

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `GOAL-STOP`, `UNDO-REMOVE`, `REMOVE-ANYTHING`
- **Budget:** at most 11 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `entry` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/goals/ci-docker` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, line 4768

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/goals/ci-docker` in the demo.
- **Check:** The goal’s summary bar shows.
- _Note:_ A goal set up by mistake beside it, with no check-ins.
- Reload the page.
- **Check:** The goal’s summary bar shows.
- **Step.** From the goal’s “…” menu (More about this goal), choose “Stop this goal”.
- **Check:** The “Stop this goal” dialog shows.
- _Note:_ A stop needs its reason.
- **Step.** Press the “Stop the goal” button in the “Stop this goal” dialog.
- **Check:** “Say why, in a sentence” is shown in the “Stop this goal” dialog (else: stopping without a reason did not ask for one).
- **Check:** (`errors`) it fails if it stopped without a reason.
- **Step.** Type “The platform team took base images over in October.” into the “Why is it stopping?” field in the “Stop this goal” dialog.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “stop dialog”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ The chart as it is now: stopping carries on with the same page, so it isn't drawn again under the message.
- **Step.** Press the “Stop the goal” button in the “Stop this goal” dialog.
- **Check:** “Stopped Base image build time” is shown (else: no message that it stopped).
- _Note:_ A stopped goal makes no forecast: no "will it hit?" on its scorecard, no projection on its chart.
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if the chart was {kept ? 'kept' : 'drawn afresh'} when the goal stopped; {forecasts} forecast marks on a stopped goal.
- _Note:_ Its page stays, marked Stopped with the reason, and no main button.
- **Check:** “Stopped” is shown in the goal’s summary bar (else: the page does not say Stopped).
- **Check:** “The platform team took base images over in October.” is shown in the goal’s summary bar (else: the page does not give the reason).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “stopped page”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if {primary} main buttons on a stopped goal; goals feeding it moved up: {moved}.
- _Note:_ The mistaken goal: no check-ins, so it's deleted; Undo brings it back.
- Go to `/goals/g-mistake` in the demo.
- **Check:** The goal’s summary bar shows.
- **Step.** From the goal’s “…” menu (More about this goal), choose “Delete this goal”.
- **Step.** Press the “Delete the goal” button in the “Delete this goal” dialog.
- **Check:** “Deleted Base image build time, again” is shown (else: no message that it was deleted).
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if stopped {g1.stoppedAt}; Goals still lists it: {listed.includes('Base image build time')}.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “undo”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the button in the message that pops up showing “Undo”.
- **Check:** “Undone” is shown (else: Undo did not say it was done).
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if the mistaken goal is {a value worked out in the journey}; logged {log.slice(-4).join(', ')}.
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
